_note: svelte2tsx copies every `// @ts-check` / `// @ts-nocheck` among the comments a script opens with to the top of the generated file, where it decides whether the component is checked; diagnostics keep their real positions. A has `@ts-check` below another comment (reported at its true column); B's `@ts-nocheck` silences its TS2322; so does C's, below a block comment, which no longer ends the run of leading comments.
